name: Second Wind
description: Once per challenge, the hero shrugs off a bad start and tries the weaker of the two demands again.

name: Lucky Break
description: Disaster keeps finding a way to be merely bad: a Critical Failure is read as an ordinary Failure.

name: Dogged
description: Refuses to fall just short — an Insufficient result is read as a Success.

name: Silver Tongue
description: A standing edge whenever persuasion is what the moment needs.
